page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.16xlarge is a general-purpose instance type belonging to the ecs.g7t family. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 64 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, resulting in 64 vCPUs. It features 256.0 GB of RAM, which translates to 4.0 GB of memory per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core processing capabilities, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, Geekbench multi-core scores, and Passmark CPU scores all ranking in the top 25% tier. The instance also demonstrates strong performance in specific workloads such as software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and database operations. However, single-core performance remains in the middle 50% average tier, as shown by stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core results. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached operations, along with Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput, also perform within the average middle 50% range.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7t.16xlarge offers a balanced resource density of 4 GB RAM per vCPU, making it a viable option for multi-threaded workloads that can leverage its 64 dedicated physical cores without requiring local storage or GPU acceleration. The lack of bundled local storage means storage costs are externalized to network-attached volumes. This instance is suited for multi-threaded applications, software compilation, database operations, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks, such as prompt processing and text generation using models up to 7B parameters.
